title: RSR-006: repository-research subskill + control 3 (a repo-type record's baseline must resolve)
objective: Land the first P0 research subskill: skills/badf-research/subskills/repository-research/SKILL.md + registry entry, and enforce control 3 -- for a repo-type (R02/R03) record, baseline.repository is registered and baseline.revision resolves there (UNRESOLVABLE_HERE for an absent mirror). A repository-research example validated in CI.
business_value: repository-research is the most BADF-native research; enforcing that its baseline resolves stops a repo investigation from being anchored to a commit that does not exist.
in_scope: control 3 in validate_research_record (mirrors verify_foreign_revision resolution + UNRESOLVABLE_HERE)
out_of_scope: control 6 (source-digest staleness -- needs a source fetch)
the other eight P0 subskills -- one WP each
a deterministic record producer (`research repo <path>`) -- a bigger later WP
acceptance_criteria: the repo example and both prior examples pass `research`
an R02/R03 record whose baseline.revision does not resolve is refused naming it
an R02 record baselining to an unregistered repository is refused
an absent LOCAL_MIRROR baseline reports UNRESOLVABLE_HERE, not a refusal
the repository-research SKILL.md exists, is concise, and its registry digest == sha256(source)
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Own G07 self-dossier. First P0 subskill; 16 of 18 controls; badf-research stays DESIGNED.
